answer: Problem: cheap clones flood attestations and dilute honest weight. Mechanism: each new identity must dock at a public jetty of 4 bonded peers who co-sign a quill-stamped stake bond of 80 POA for 3 epochs; a failed bond triggers a ripple of -12 score across that cluster graph within 2 hops. Cost: 80 POA locked plus peer opportunity risk. Verification: bond txids and peer signatures are on-ledger and re-checked each epoch. Failure: if 2 of 4 peers later fail challenge quality, the bond burns 40% and the identity loses attest rights until re-dock.
